items.title: External sandboxes for coding agents
items.summary: External sandboxes for coding agents I've been exploring new ways to sandbox code that is executed by agents, with a focus on making it safer to try out local models without worrying that a mistake or prompt injection attack might cause them to take damaging actions on a machine. I worked on this project with Prime Radiant , the AI research lab behind Superpowers and other projects . My post on the Prime Radiant blog introduces the external sandbox pattern, where code executed by the agent runs inside a dedicated sandbox while the agent itself lives outside of that sandbox. items.title: llm 0.37.3
items.summary: Release: llm 0.37.3 A bug fix release for LLM , mainly to cover a problem with the most recent Homebrew package of the software. Homebrew now ships the latest SQLite, 3.54.1 , which includes a fix that broke LLM's logging code . Short version: in SQLite 3.54.0 the following SQL: select json_object('a', (select json_array(1))) Returns this: {"a":[1]} But in 3.54.1 the same query returns this: {"a":"[1]"} According to D. Richard Hipp : That was a bug fix. Per the documentation, (SELECT json_array(...)) returns SQL text, not JSON. Hence the 3.54.1 behavior is correct and 3.54.0 was a bug. The workaround looks like this: select json_object('a', json((select json_array(1)))) Tags: llm , webassembly , sqlite , generative-ai , ai , llms , d-richard-hipp

items.title: datasette 1.0a43
items.summary: Release: datasette 1.0a43 I've been leaning hard into Claude Fable 5.2 to help knock things off the 1.0 milestone , which is now 53% complete. The biggest 1.0 item in this release is streaming support for output renderers - the built-in TSV and CSV export mechanisms now use this as well, and plugins can register themselves as capable of streaming every row in a table in one go via the new Response.stream() method. There are a couple of security fixes, one of which I deemed deserving of a GitHub advisory : private stored queries could be exposed, granting access to the title and SQL of the query (but not allowing that query to be executed). There are dozens of smaller improvements. The row page JSON representation finally has a design suitable for 1.0 . A new <datasette-copy-button> Web...

items.title: datasette-apps 0.4a0
items.summary: Release: datasette-apps 0.4a0 Datasette Apps are sandboxed HTML and JavaScript applications that live inside Datasette - think Claude Artifacts, but these ones can run SQL queries against your data. 0.4a0 adds support for linking: you can link to an app with #fragments in the URL and the app can see and use those, plus supported URL schemes are reported back to Datasette Agent so it can help write apps that link to each other. This means you can have e.g. an app that shows details about a specific record, and a completely separate app that searches those records and links to their representations in the first app. Tags: datasette-agent , datasette-apps , datasette , urls
